svg.title: Gilil On — cyan — navy front face and one soft cast shadow only
svg.desc: Upper Gilil: one solid navy #102A4C face, no bevel, side faces, extrusion or highlights, plus one vector soft-shadow group matched to On. Original On and base scene retained. Front contours use the earlier faithful first-face reconstruction clipped to the approved body; not a recoverable author first layer. Revealed background beneath removed baked depth is locally reconstructed in the original cyan palette. No embedded raster or fonts.
